name: Treshala's Pendant
summary: In Razorfen Kraul, a pendant carries the bond between Treshala and Heralath Fallowbrook. Heralath brought it from their home in Darnassus into southern Kalimdor, where the quilboar tore it from him as he lay dying.

sections.title: Token of Devotion
sections.body: Heralath Fallowbrook carried the pendant close when he left Teldrassil on perilous journeys. The necklace reminded him of home and of his beloved wife, Treshala, and the devotion they shared.

sections.title: Lost in the Briars
sections.body: Heralath ventured into Razorfen Kraul with his party, where savage quilboar fell upon them. In his final moments, one of the tusked defenders tore the pendant from him. As his life ebbed away, Heralath asked a passing adventurer to wrest the keepsake from his killers and carry it, with news of his fate, home to Treshala in Darnassus.

faq.answer: Treshala's Pendant belongs to Treshala Fallowbrook. Her husband Heralath carried it as a keepsake of their union before he met his end in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: How did the pendant end up in Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook carried the pendant on an expedition into Razorfen Kraul. After quilboar ambushed and mortally wounded him, one of them took the necklace from him.

faq.q: Who asks for the pendant to be recovered?
faq.answer: As he lies dying in Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook begs passing adventurers to recover the pendant and return it to his wife in Darnassus with news of his death.

faq.q: Who receives the pendant once it is recovered?
aliases: where do i take the pendant
faq.answer: Treshala Fallowbrook receives the recovered pendant. Heralath's widow lives in Darnassus, the night elf capital atop Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can honor a fellow kaldorei who perished far from the safety of Teldrassil's boughs by recovering the pendant.
As an Alliance member, you can carry the token to Darnassus and bring somber closure to a widow mourning her fallen explorer.
